subject.title: fix(sessions): use account names for direct display

question: Should `sessions.list` use a configured channel account name as the fallback display and search identity for an otherwise opaque direct-session peer id?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and proof-positive, but it deliberately changes the established display fallback for existing session rows rather than repairing a specified runtime failure.

options.title: Accept account-name fallback
options.body: Merge the narrow fallback after a current-main refresh, retaining explicit labels and meaningful origin labels as stronger identities.

options.title: Keep peer-id fallback
options.body: Reject this precedence change and retain opaque peer identifiers unless a future session-identity policy defines a broader ordering.

recommendation.title: Accept account-name fallback
recommendation.body: Merge the narrow fallback after a current-main refresh, retaining explicit labels and meaningful origin labels as stronger identities.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged adjacent Feishu session-label work is the strongest available feature-history routing signal, although the history evidence is indirect.
